text.content:
Classification: High Clan

The Clan of Shadows considers itself first among equals — the epitome of Cainite existence and inheritor of Caine's glory. Lasombra trace their founding to the shores of the Mediterranean; their empire is centered on Castel d'Ombra on Sicily, where their founder is said to lie in uneasy torpor, served by his regent Montano. Lasombra hunger for power in every form, from cloisters to royal palaces, and many seek influence within the Church. The spread of Islam has split the clan's secret ruling council, the Amici Noctis, along religious lines, sparking a "Shadow Reconquista" between Christian and Muslim Lasombra in Iberia. All factions of the clan unite, however, in a crusade against the Cainite Heresy, whose ruling Crimson Curia is dominated by Lasombra Heretics.

Disciplines: Dominate, Obtenebration, Potence

Advantage: Lasombra carry themselves with undeniable dignity, gaining a free Status Trait. Many were nobility or clergy in life, granting one free Trait of Church, Learning or Political Influence.

Disadvantage: Lasombra cast no reflection in mirrors or other reflective surfaces such as pools of water or quicksilver. Their affinity for shadow makes them especially vulnerable to light: sunlight inflicts an extra level of aggravated damage.

Organization: Choose only those of noble blood, the best and brightest; those who cannot measure up are excised quickly. Members hold high positions throughout the Byzantine Empire, Italy, Iberia and North Africa.

Suggested Viae: Heaven, Kings. A few walk the clan's own Road of Night.
